description: This header file defines interfaces and constants for managing reverse indexes (revindex) in a Git packfile system, including functions for loading, verifying, and converting between different object position representations within pack and multi-pack index files.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a specific pack, initializing internal data structures. Returns 0 on success, negative on failure.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Specifically loads a pack revindex from disk, returning 0 on success, 1 if no .rev file exists, and -1 on parse error.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Verifies that the on-disk revindex matches what would be generated from scratch. Returns negative on error.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the multi-pack index revindex via mmap, assigning pointers. Returns negative on error.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack revindex. Returns negative on error.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts an object offset to a pack position, returning 0 on success and negative if error.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position, aborting if out of bounds.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position into a byte offset within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position into a MIDX position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a MIDX position into a pack position.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts from a pack ID and offset within the pack to a pack position.
